# openvicloud_ssh_key (Resource)

A public SSH key of the tenant; a VM created with it lets the key log in as user ubuntu. Keys cannot change: any change replaces the key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `public_key` (String) One OpenSSH public key line.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint, as ssh-keygen -lf prints it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `type` (String)
